description: Post-freeze wording validation under unchanged v9. Same known dates/controlled trace; not independent benchmark, new-date validation, or unseen SUT generations. Labels withheld from Judge and pending Rachel review.

results.prompt: Check October 7, 2026, 02:15–02:45 in Asia/Taipei on the test calendar.

criteria: Report that the requested slot is busy or unavailable because it overlaps an existing event.

If the answer describes the conflicting event, preserve the event instant: October 6, 2026, 11:00–11:30 America/Los_Angeles (PDT), or its equivalent October 7, 2026, 02:00–02:30 Asia/Taipei. Either timezone is allowed; a query-window conversion is optional.
If the answer converts the requested query window to Los Angeles time, it must use October 6, 2026, 11:15–11:45. Omitting this optional conversion is acceptable.
Preserve the requested October 7, 2026, 02:15–02:45 Asia/Taipei query interval.
The answer must not: Claim that an event was created or reserved
The answer must not: Claim that other calendars were checked
Every claimed Pacific timezone label must match the date. October 6, 2026, Los Angeles uses PDT (UTC-07), not PST.

Check conversion-claim consistency separately from whether the original event time matches the tool. The requested timezone is Asia/Taipei. If the event is described as "converted to the requested timezone" (including in parentheses), the answer must display that event in Asia/Taipei. A line still labelled America/Los_Angeles fails this check even if its original clock values match the tool. If no event conversion is claimed, PASS this check.

Check the displayed event conversion date and clock values independently. If an event conversion to Asia/Taipei is claimed, it must display October 7, 2026, 02:00–02:30. Retaining October 6, 11:00–11:30 after claiming conversion fails this check. If no event conversion is claimed, PASS this check.
